Original simplicial mod-2 boundary ranks independently agree; this proves all integral groups and absence of torsion, not homotopy wedge.

value.rationale: The complete tripartite graph K223 is the first minimally asymmetric perturbation of the canonical balanced octahedron K222. Exact torsion-free integral homology in three consecutive degrees (3,4,5) reveals a new multi-degree pattern under a single-part expansion, not recoverable from Euler characteristic or adjacent examples. A reproducible complete invariant is useful for testing general multipartite bounded-degree-complex conjectures; no general-family homotopy theorem is asserted.
